problem_text: Let p be an odd prime number. How many p-element subsets A of {1, 2, ..., 2p} are there, the sum of whose elements is divisible by p?
solution_text: Define a cyclic shift sigma on {1,...,p} by sigma(x) = x mod p + 1 (i.e., 1->2->...->p->1), and the identity on {p+1,...,2p}. This gives a Z/pZ action on p-element subsets of {1,...,2p}. Key lemma: sum(sigma(A)) ≡ sum(A) + |A ∩ {1,...,p}| (mod p), and after i iterations: sum(sigma^i(A)) ≡ sum(A) + i·|A ∩ {1,...,p}| (mod p). For non-exceptional subsets A (not {1,...,p} or {p+1,...,2p}), |A ∩ {1,...,p}| is between 1 and p-1, hence nonzero mod p. The linear function sum(A) + i·|A ∩ {1,...,p}| over Z/pZ has exactly one zero, so each orbit of size p contributes exactly one good subset. The C(2p,p)-2 non-exceptional subsets partition into orbits of size p, giving (C(2p,p)-2)/p good subsets. The two exceptional subsets {1,...,p} and {p+1,...,2p} both have sum divisible by p (since p is odd, sum = p(p+1)/2). Total = 2 + (C(2p,p)-2)/p.
solution_summary: Define cyclic shift on {1,...,p} only (identity on {p+1,...,2p}); sum changes linearly as sum(A)+i·|A∩{1,...,p}| mod p; each orbit of size p has exactly one good subset; answer = 2 + (C(2p,p)-2)/p.
structure_features: Count p-element subsets of {1,...,2p} with sum divisible by p; involves Z/pZ group action and orbit counting; split universe into {1,...,p} and {p+1,...,2p}, cyclic shift acts only on first half
key_insight: Define cyclic shift on {1,...,p} only (identity on {p+1,...,2p}); the sum changes linearly as sum(A)+i·|A∩{1,...,p}| mod p, and nonzero coefficient means each orbit contributes exactly one good subset

correct_method: Define cyclic group action (shift on first half only), use orbit structure and linear sum formula, each orbit of size p contributes exactly one good subset, plus 2 exceptional subsets

rounds.question: 描述这道题的结构：已知什么、求什么、有哪些关键数学对象？
rounds.expected_answer: 已知奇素数p，求{1,...,2p}的p元子集中元素和被p整除的子集个数。总共有C(2p,p)个p元子集，需要筛选和≡0 mod p的。关键对象：奇素数p、p元子集、模p整除条件。

rounds.question: 列出你能想到的所有方法来计数满足模条件的子集。
rounds.expected_answer: 直接枚举、生成函数、Burnside引理/群作用、模算术、双重计数、归纳法、容斥原理...

rounds.question: 试试p=3的情况，计算{1,...,6}的3元子集中和被3整除的有多少个？C(6,3)-2是否被3整除？
考虑定义一个循环群作用在子集上。在{1,...,p}上定义什么自然的循环作用？{p+1,...,2p}呢？
rounds.expected_answer: 在{1,...,p}上定义循环移位σ(x)=x%p+1（即1→2→...→p→1），在{p+1,...,2p}上保持恒等。这给出Z/pZ在{1,...,2p}上的作用，进而作用在p元子集上。

rounds.question: 在这个移位作用下，子集A的元素和如何变化？用|A∩{1,...,p}|表示。
rounds.expected_answer: sum(σA) ≡ sum(A) + |A∩{1,...,p}| (mod p)，因为{1,...,p}中的每个元素加1，其余不变。迭代i次：sum(σ^i A) ≡ sum(A) + i·|A∩{1,...,p}| (mod p)。

rounds.question: 当|A∩{1,...,p}| ≠ 0 mod p时，i从0到p-1中恰好几个使sum(σ^i A) ≡ 0？哪些子集是例外？
rounds.expected_answer: 线性函数sum(A)+i·|A∩{1,...,p}|在Z/pZ上恰好一个零点（因为系数非零），所以每个轨道恰好一个好子集。例外是|A∩{1,...,p}|=0或p的子集，即{p+1,...,2p}和{1,...,p}，它们的和都被p整除（p为奇数时sum=p(p+1)/2）。

rounds.question: 你已经有了所有要素。组装最终答案：非特殊子集的轨道贡献+特殊子集。
rounds.expected_answer: C(2p,p)-2个非特殊子集分成大小p的轨道，每个轨道1个好子集，共(C(2p,p)-2)/p个。加上2个特殊子集，总数=2+(C(2p,p)-2)/p。

analysis_metadata.notes: IMO 1995 P6 - classic group action orbit counting problem. Key difficulty is recognizing the partial cyclic shift on {1,...,p} only. The answer 2+(C(2p,p)-2)/p is a clean formula. No new topology dimensions needed.
